name: Porter County, IN
findings: Porter County has 539 nonprofit organizations. 217 of them (40%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 173 organizations.
Social and fraternal organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (25% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, Porter County has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: Education organizations stand out for public events
observations.text: 18 education organizations here list public events, compared with about 8 in similar places of this size.

confidence.text: Based on 18 organizations here; 40% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: What role do education organizations play in community life here? Who do they reach, and who might they miss?

observations.title: Social and fraternal organizations that list no opportunities
observations.text: 29 social and fraternal organizations here list none of the four kinds of opportunity in their tax returns or on their websites. Many may still offer them without describing them there.

confidence.text: Based on 29 organizations here; 40% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: What do social and fraternal organizations here do in the community? How do people find out about them?

observations.title: Few hobby and sports organizations list public events
observations.text: 5 hobby and sports organizations here list public events. In similar places of this size, about 12 would.

confidence.text: Based on 12 organizations here; 40% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: Do people here look for public events through hobby and sports groups? Where else does that happen?

observations.title: Fewer organizations list civic or political action
observations.text: Per resident, fewer organizations in Porter County list civic or political action in their tax returns or on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 67% of the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 6 organizations here; 40% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: Does that match what people here experience? Where do people find ways to take civic or political action now, including outside formal organizations?
